::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 8th [1883]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.[^1]
:::

Dear [Charles](people/person_1043.qmd),

&nbsp;

I send you the M S of the story of Burrs hoping that it may help your Christmas number, and not be too youthful

Thank you for the Magazine

Yours truly
C M Yonge

Some of the pencil numbers are missing but the arrangement is all right

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd/ C Moor/Great Grimsby. Postmarked Winchester Oc 8/83.

**Note:** Charles Moor, who was perhaps running a parish magazine, had asked her for a story, and she sent him the MS of one which was about to be published in *Langley Adventures*.
